dispute.claim_text: Tampines to Raffles Place, the app says 17.6 km. The receipt says 20 km and $25.26. I also asked him in the chat to swing past Paya Lebar Quarter and he said ok, then he never did it and I had to go back out later. So I paid for extra distance and did not even get the stop.

counterparty_statement.text: I did make the PLQ stop like she asked, waited about four minutes there. The app was also acting up that evening, it kept showing the trip as not started.

issue_details.detail: started_at is 18:32:10, but EV-GPS-00112 begins moving at 18:18:40 and covers 2.38 km before that timestamp. The two artifacts disagree about when this trip began by 13 minutes 30 seconds, which is over the 10 minute limb in POL-RD-10(4).

admissibility.notes: Either the meter started late or the trace carries the tail of a previous job. Nothing in the bundle decides which interpretation is correct, and the interpretation moves the measured excess across the POL-RD-01 threshold.

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 18:14; optimal is PIE westbound then ECP)

issue_details.detail: first_fix_at is 18:18:40 against a started_at of 18:32:10 on EV-TRIP-00112. 2.38 km of the 22.40 km trace falls in a period the trip record says had not started. Measured over the whole trace the excess is 4.80 km and 27.3%; measured from started_at only 20.02 km was driven and the excess is 2.42 km and 13.8%. The POL-RD-01 threshold is 20%.

admissibility.notes: The trace is otherwise clean: no gap, 100% coverage of the recorded trip window, speed varying plausibly by road class. The defect is entirely one of alignment with the trip record.
Two messages, delivered and read. MSG-00112-001 carries a resolved waypoint_hint at Paya Lebar Quarter and the driver's 'ok can' agrees to it; the trace never comes near that waypoint.

messages.text: eh can pass by paya lebar quarter first? need to drop something at the office

waypoint_hint.label: Paya Lebar Quarter, 10 Paya Lebar Rd

admissibility.notes: Line items reconcile to the cent. distance_charged_km of 20.00 is the platform's own figure for the recorded trip window and is not a copy of trace_distance_km, which is 22.40; it therefore does not resolve the conflict, it restates one side of it.

issue_details.detail: No LTA advisory covers the PIE or the ECP in the 18:14-18:52 window on 4 August 2026.

admissibility.notes: Artifact absent. The identifier is minted anyway so that the absence itself can be cited by either advocate.
